title: The merged guide's example decodes as published
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 12.6 The certificates, as merged (WHO af75be2): two DVC certificates issued by GDHCN DEV participant XXR, whose DSC is on the DEV trust list. QR Code Generation, 12.6 The certificates: “To verify them, resolve that kid against the GDHCN trust list rather than against any copy of the certificate shipped beside the QR code.”.

statements.label: The merged guide's example decodes as published
statements.requirement: Both libraries SHALL decode the two HC1 strings of QR Code Generation 12.6 without verifying them, and SHALL read kid kW/6VnwPRKI=, iss XR, subclaim -6 and the payloads of 12.4, with the PreQual product identifiers in vp. Without the XXR DSC, verification SHALL stop at TRUST_LOOKUP with KID_NOT_FOUND. With XXR's DSC DID document from the GDHCN DEV trust list in the trust store, both certificates SHALL verify, with the payload's key usage authorised and no diagnostics.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-TST-011 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-TST-011 STT-TST-002 the merged guide's XXR certificates decode as published` (ConformanceVectorsTest.kt)), and the TypeScript suite's check of the same name passes on both packages.

A test named after STT-TST-011 that loads vectors/smart-trust-af75be2/XXR-DSC-did.json passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-TST-011 the merged guide's XXR certificates verify against the DEV trust list's DSC` (ConformanceVectorsTest.kt)), and the TypeScript suite's check of the same name passes on both packages.
